records.title: Eskimo Folk-Tales
ancientAuthors: Greenlandic storytellers; collected by Knud Rasmussen
records.translator: Edited and translated into English by W. J. Alexander Worster
records.rightsStatus: Project Gutenberg public-domain edition; preserve attribution and review UK reuse before redistribution.
records.notes: Stories collected by Rasmussen in various parts of Greenland and selected/edited by Worster for an English popular collection. The book title uses an outdated ethnonym; individual teller provenance is not consistently supplied.

records.title: A Treasury of Eskimo Tales
records.rightsStatus: Project Gutenberg public-domain edition; preserve attribution and review UK reuse before redistribution.
records.notes: A 1922 juvenile compilation drawing separately on Central Inuit and Bering Strait sources from U.S. Ethnological Reports. These communities should not be collapsed into one generic Inuit tradition.
